problem_type: Receipt authority visibility across pi durable write boundaries
symptom: An approved canvas write is rejected by the renderer receipt request while its tool is executing.
direct_cause: appendCustomEntry persists the approval as a queued custom write during before_tool; the receipt lookup only sees the transcript projection until the tool finishes.
class_root: Receipt authorization uses a presentation subset instead of the complete durable lane snapshot.
affected_population: Authority notes while queued writes become transcript entries
entry_points: Renderer preparing or committed receipt request
internal_only_reason: The installed pi 0.85.1 public LaneSnapshot exposes transcript and queues; an actual AgentHarness loopback fixture proves their ordering. Nomi owns receipt correlation.
invariants: A receipt lookup reads transcript and queued custom writes from the same lane snapshot.
A persisted entry counts once by entry ID; conflicting duplicates or multiple authorities for one proposal fail closed.
Only validated authority fields authorize a receipt; the UI transcript remains ordered and unchanged.
generality_proof: The same pure lookup handles pending, committed, replayed and duplicate representations of durable authority without a second authorization store.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate and uniquely identify receipt authority in a complete pi snapshot.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: before_tool writes are visible here before the real tool executor starts.
Completed and cold reopened authority uses the same validation and entry identity.
Presentation keeps transcript order and deliberately excludes queued writes; it is no longer the authority lookup input.

recurrence.reason: Every approved tool that requests a receipt before finishing crosses the same durable queue boundary.
same_class_scan: Traced laneDesktopTools approved through laneHost before_tool and renderer proposalUndo receipt preparation.
Read pi LaneSnapshot, LaneQueuedItem and CustomEntry public types; probed before_tool, execute and post-run snapshots.

prevention.invariant: Authorization is derived from one complete durable snapshot with strict uniqueness checks.
prevention.failure_mode: Malformed or ambiguous authority throws; absent authority returns undefined for the receipt correlation guard to reject.
prevention.strategy: Read both pi-owned durable representations without changing projection or caching authorization.

legacy_paths.rationale: The pure query adds no persistence or execution path; its caller replaces the transcript-only authorization lookup.

dependency_lifecycle.target: A supported pi release retaining durable queued custom writes in LaneSnapshot.
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Queueing during an operation is intended upstream behavior; Nomi must query the public durable state correctly.
exit_criteria: When pi changes LaneSnapshot or custom-write commit ordering, rerun the real before_tool-to-execute and cold-reopen fixtures before upgrading.

migration: No format migration: existing custom authority notes remain readable through the same public pi snapshot.
residual_risks: The pure helper requires the host and receipt command to pass the current snapshot-derived authority; their forwarding is reviewed separately.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The snapshot query is the earliest shared boundary with both pi durable representations and the application receipt identity.
